description_en: Queries the IP or VPC whitelist of an instance. Only new-architecture instances are supported, that is, instances whose VPC access point (or VPC PrivateLink access point) ends with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
查询实例ip/vpc白名单；
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: ListInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance whose whitelist you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询白名单的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type. Valid values:

1: IP whitelist type.

2: VPC ID whitelist type
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。

WhiteListType为1，IP白名单类型；

WhiteListType为2，VPCID白名单类型；
parameters.name: white_list_type

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The request result, which contains the specific VPC ID or IP whitelist values. Each entry includes an id and a value. The id is a sequence number that can be used for deletion. The value is the actual whitelist entry
Data.description_zh: 请求结果：VPCID或者IP白名单具体值，包含id和value两部份。id是序号，可用于删除；value是具体值

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
Message.description_zh: 请求错误时，返回错误信息

StatusCode.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
